notes: Buying progressively rarer dogs from a shop and spawning them into your own pen is a collection simulator, so Simulation leads; Roleplay & Avatar Sim's Pet Care was rejected because there is no town, no housing and no caring for the animals, and the goal answer confirms collecting is the entire game. The preset is Incremental Simulator for that shop-and-rarity mode, but its shared world shape is replaced by plot-isolated, since the free-text answer gives every player their own pen of six rather than one common world. I dropped the preset's gate-progression because rarity is priced at the shop counter rather than walled off as ground you buy your way into, and kept a walkable route from the shop out to the pens. The dogs and their cages are carried as the collectible the loop is built on, with the stated six-per-pen limit and the greyhound as the top rarity noted here since the config has nowhere else to hold a count.
